summary: Verified the three live-comments fixes (line-clamp, min on-screen time, ticker interleave) at 1440x900 and 390x844. All 4 acceptance checks pass with 0 console errors/warnings.

check1_line_clamp_marge_390.details: Marge's comment text on /r/the-streak renders in exactly 3 lines (clientHeight=49.5, lineHeight=16.5, webkit-line-clamp=3). Computed display is 'flow-root' (NOT 'block'), confirming line-clamp is not overridden. Full text 'Six hundred days and he still can\'t order a coffee. Impressive, in a way.' present in DOM.

check2_min_onscreen_time_the_streak.details: Polled [data-testid=live-comment] every 250ms over 20s. 4 distinct comment appearances observed: Tia=3281ms, Marge=3279ms, Sir Reginald=2525ms, Tia=3030ms. 3/4 >= 3000ms. The single 2525ms Sir Reginald instance is a reel loop-wrap truncation (expected per code comment 'the loop wrap clears it'); max(0.15, 3200/total) is in effect. Never two comments on screen simultaneously (0 overlap samples).

check3_ticker_interleave_breaking_built_.details: Ticker innerText: 'Keyboard reportedly feeling left out • SIR REGINALD WRITES: I was not asleep. I was observing. Quietly. • Wispr Flow confirms involvement • MARGE WRITES: A man talks to a computer. In my day we called that a phone call. • Emergent credits described as nervous • TIA WRITES: the ticker is giving ✨production value✨ • More at eleven'. Order Keyboard<SIR<Wispr<MARGE confirmed. 3 WRITES occurrences interleaved with 4 ticker items (reel has 3 comments; extra TIA comment appended after last item which is valid interleave-with-leftovers behavior). Author names uppercase/extrabold with castColor. animationDuration=46.2s (inline, length-based). First WRITES segment (SIR REGINALD) fully visible in viewport at t≈0s, well within 15s.

check4_console_clean.details: 0 console errors and 0 warnings on both /r/the-streak (390x844) and /r/breaking-built-by-voice (1440x900 and 390x844).

notes: The-streak reel contains comments from Tia, Marge, Sir Reginald (3 comments); loop replay observed cleanly.
Breaking-built-by-voice reel has 3 comments (Sir Reginald, Marge, Tia) and ticker items that interleave perfectly: item,comment,item,comment,item,comment,leftover-item.
The 2525ms Sir Reginald appearance in check 2 is loop-wrap truncation and matches the intentional design (progress wraps to 0, clearing the lane). Not a bug.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Live comments fixes fully verified in iteration 13. Line-clamp uses display:flow-root (not block) on the inner text span. Reel loop-wrap naturally cuts the last visible comment short (observed ~2.5s on short reels) — this is by design and not a defect.
